plan.archetype: Efficient attacks transitioning into poison scaling and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Upgrade core poison and defense; preserve a useful potion and healthy entry. Push through the 160-HP stun threshold, then sustain damage while blocking.
plan.summary: Add immediate damage first, including an efficient AoE attack. Develop reliable poison before taking its payoff powers. Improve defense and draw, remove basics gradually, and fight elites only with adequate resources.

plan.archetype: Accelerated poison with dexterity defense and efficient draw
plan.bossPrep: Recover health, obtain poison acceleration, and upgrade core poison or Footwork when safe. Preserve useful potions and sustain damage after the stun threshold.
plan.summary: Three poison cards need acceleration, draw, and stronger defense—not additional basic poison. Recover health, upgrade key cards when safe, and avoid extra elites.
